content: I can’t determine the most likely next items from only “item 271” without transaction or co-purchase data. If you provide the dataset or model outputs, I can rank the 10 item IDs.
prompt:

Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
